Motor Components.name: Epoxy resins
Motor Components.reasoning: Epoxy resins are used as insulation and binding agents for windings, commonly used with alternatives existing.

Permanent Magnet Rotor Assembly.name: Boron
Permanent Magnet Rotor Assembly.reasoning: Boron is used with Neodymium and Iron in permanent magnets to increase magnetic strength and stability, industry standard.

Motor Housing.name: Steel Ingots
